definition_zh: 受托人；财产管理人；理事
definition_en: a person who holds and manages property or rights for the benefit of another
core_image: 一双手握着别人的钥匙，只按约定开哪扇门
scene: 老人立下遗嘱，把房子交给一位受托人打理，租金留给子女。The trustee must keep the house in good repair and pay the taxes from the estate.
sceneCN: 这里 trustee 是「受托人」（第 1 个义项：代他人持有并管理财产的人）；句意：受托人必须维护好房子，并从遗产中支付税款。

pos.zh: 受托人；财产管理人；理事

derivatives.zh: 受托人职位；托管：trust + -ship（表示身份与职位的后缀）
委托；托付：en-（使）+ trust，把事物交到所信任的人手里
信托设立人；委托人：trust + -or（施动者后缀），指设立信托的一方

senses.title: A person who holds property for another
senses.definition: a person or company that holds and manages property or money for the benefit of someone else
senses.definitionCN: 为他人利益持有并管理财产或金钱的个人或公司
senses.example: The trustee holds the land for the children until they reach the age of majority.
senses.exampleCN: 受托人为孩子们持有这块土地，直到他们成年。
senses.why: The ending -ee marks the receiver of an action, so a trustee is the one to whom property is entrusted.
senses.whyCN: -ee 标记动作的承受者，因此 trustee 就是财产被托付给的那个人。

senses.title: A manager of a bankrupt estate
senses.definition: an official appointed to take control of a bankrupt person or company and to pay the creditors
senses.definitionCN: 被指定接管破产个人或公司并偿付债权人的官员
senses.example: The court appointed a trustee to sell the factory and pay the creditors.
senses.exampleCN: 法院指定了一名财产管理人，负责出售工厂并偿付债权人。
senses.why: When a debtor cannot pay, the law puts the property into neutral hands, and that hand is the trustee.
senses.whyCN: 当债务人付不出钱时，法律把财产交给中立的一方，这一方就是受托人。

senses.title: A member of a governing board
senses.definition: a member of a board that governs a school, museum, charity, or pension fund
senses.definitionCN: 管理学校、博物馆、慈善机构或养老基金的理事会成员
senses.example: She served as a trustee of the museum for twelve years.
senses.exampleCN: 她担任博物馆理事十二年。
senses.why: A board holds an institution in trust for the public, so each of its members is called a trustee.
senses.whyCN: 理事会为公众托管一个机构，因此每位成员都被称作受托人。

senses.title: One trusted with a duty
senses.definition: a person trusted with responsibility for something valuable
senses.definitionCN: 被信赖并托付贵重事物之责任的人
senses.example: The club made him a trustee of its small savings fund.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部让他担任小额储备金的受托管理者。
senses.why: The ending -ee names the receiving side of trust, not only of property, so any trusted duty can carry the name.
senses.whyCN: -ee 词尾指接受信任的一方，并不限于财产，因此任何受重托的职责都能沿用这个名称。

senses.title: The holder of legal title for a beneficiary
senses.titleCN: 名义持有人（为受益人持有法定所有权）
senses.definition: the person in whom legal title to property is vested while another person enjoys the benefit
senses.definitionCN: 财产法定所有权归于其名下、而由另一人享有利益的人
senses.example: Legal title sits with the trustee, while the beneficiary takes the income.
senses.exampleCN: 法定所有权归于受托人，受益人则取得收益。
senses.why: Trust law splits ownership: the trustee keeps the legal title while the beneficiary keeps the use.
senses.whyCN: 信托法把所有权拆开：受托人保留法定名义，受益人保留使用与收益。

senses.title: A corporate trustee
senses.definition: a trust company or bank that performs trustee duties for clients
senses.definitionCN: 为客户履行受托职责的信托公司或银行
senses.example: A corporate trustee administers the fund when no individual is named.
senses.exampleCN: 没有指定个人时，由法人受托机构管理该基金。
senses.why: The role can be filled by an institution, and the name follows the function rather than the body.
senses.whyCN: 这个角色可以由机构担任，名称随职能走，而不随担任者是人还是公司走。

intro.en: Trustee joins trust, a Germanic word for confidence, with -ee, the French ending for the person who receives an action.
intro.cn: trustee 由表示「信赖」的 trust（源自日耳曼语）加上 -ee（法语中表示动作承受者的词尾）构成。

items.cn: 重构形式 *traust- 意为援助、信心与支持。

items.en: Traust carries the sense of confidence and protection into English.
items.cn: traust 把信赖与保护的意味带进英语。

items.en: The ending -é, from Latin -atus, names the person who receives the action.
items.cn: 词尾 -é 源自拉丁语 -atus，指动作的承受者。

items.en: Trust names both confidence and the property handed over in confidence.
items.cn: 中古英语 trust 既指信赖，也指因信赖而交付的财产。

items.en: Trustee appears as a person in whom confidence is placed.
items.cn: 十五世纪 trustee 出现，指受到信赖的人。

items.en: Modern English adds the legal holder of property and the corporate trustee.
items.cn: 现代英语加入持有财产的法定受托人与法人受托机构。

note.en: Trustee sits in the trust family and neighbours the officials who manage property for others.
note.cn: trustee 属于 trust 词族，并与代他人管理财产的各种职务相邻。

entries.definition: confidence, or property held for another
entries.definitionCN: 信任；信托财产（trustee 的基础词）

entries.definition: the office or role of a trustee
to give something into the care of another
entries.definitionCN: 委托；把事物交给他人照管

entries.definition: a person appointed to manage the affairs of a company or an estate
a person who has care of property or valuables
a person who carries out the terms of a will

normalIntro.en: Trustee is built from trust plus the receiver ending -ee, so the word itself points to the person who is trusted.
normalIntro.cn: trustee 由 trust 加表示承受者的词尾 -ee 构成，词形本身就在指被信任的那个人。

normal.en: Trust plus -ee: the ending points to the person who receives the trust.
normal.cn: trust 加 -ee：这个词尾指向接受信任的人。

normal.en: A trustee is the mirror of a trustor: one receives the property, the other hands it over.
normal.cn: 受托人正好与信托设立人相对：一方接收财产，另一方交付财产。

normal.en: In bankruptcy, the trustee is the official who gathers the assets and pays the creditors.
normal.cn: 在破产案件中，受托人是归集资产、偿付债权人的官员。

normal.en: Board of trustees keeps the plural because a board has many members.
normal.cn: 「board of trustees」用复数，因为理事会由多位成员组成。

normal.en: Compare employee and trustee: both are -ee words naming the receiving side.
normal.cn: 对比 employee 与 trustee：两者都是 -ee 词，指接受的一方。

abstract.en: Picture two hands on one key: the owner keeps the right, the trustee keeps the key.
abstract.cn: 想象两双手共握一把钥匙：主人保留权利，受托人保管钥匙。

abstract.en: See a locked shop, a court officer holding the key and paying the queue of creditors.
abstract.cn: 想象一家上锁的店铺，法院官员拿着钥匙，依次偿付排队的债权人。

abstract.en: Think of a row of chairs at a museum table, each name plate reading trustee.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆长桌旁的一排椅子，每张名牌上都写着受托人。

examples.en: The trustee sold the shares and distributed the money to the beneficiaries.
examples.cn: 受托人卖掉了股票，把钱分给了受益人。

examples.en: She was appointed trustee of the charity in the spring.
examples.cn: 她在春天被任命为这家慈善机构的受托人。

examples.en: Trustees must act only in the interest of the people they serve.
examples.cn: 受托人只能为他们所服务的人的利益行事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「托事替」——受托人替人托事、替人管事；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: trust（信赖；信托，一般认为源自古诺斯语 traust，并受古法语影响）+ -ee（被……的人，源自拉丁语 -atus）→ trustee，核心义「被托付的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Trustee begins with the person who holds property for another, then widens to bankruptcy managers, board members, trusted bearers of duty, legal title holders, and corporate trust companies.
sensesIntro.cn: trustee 从「代他人持有财产的人」出发，扩展到破产财产管理人、理事、受重托者、法定名义持有人与法人受托机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands on one key that belongs to someone else.
core.cn: 核心意象：两双手共握一把属于别人的钥匙。

branches.en: Holding property for a beneficiary is the core legal sense.
branches.cn: 为受益人持有财产是核心的法律义项。

branches.en: Court-appointed management of a bankrupt estate is the insolvency sense.
branches.cn: 法院指定管理破产财产，是破产语境中的义项。

branches.en: Board membership borrows the name for institutional custody.
branches.cn: 理事身份借用这个名称，指对机构的托管。

branches.en: Trusted duty and corporate trustees extend the role beyond private persons.
branches.cn: 受重托的职责与法人受托机构，把这一角色扩展到个人之外。

branches.en: Title and benefit are split between the trustee and the beneficiary.
branches.cn: 法定名义与受益权在受托人与受益人之间分开。

intro.en: Trustee is not built from a Latin prefix: it is trust, a Germanic word for confidence, carrying the French receiver ending -ee.
intro.cn: trustee 不是由拉丁语前缀构成：它是表示信赖的日耳曼语词 trust，加上法语中表示承受者的词尾 -ee。

latinIntro.en: The -ee ending descends from Latin -atus, the past-participle ending that Old French reduced to -é.
latinIntro.cn: -ee 词尾可追溯到拉丁语 -atus，即过去分词词尾，古法语把它简化为 -é。

items.example: Trust is the base word behind trustee.
items.exampleCN: trust 是 trustee 背后的基础词。

items.meaning: the person who receives an action
items.example: The suffix -ee forms trustee, employee, and nominee.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ee 构成 trustee、employee 与 nominee。

items.meaning: one who holds property for another
items.example: Trustee adds the receiver ending to trust.
items.exampleCN: trustee 在 trust 后面加上承受者词尾。

items.meaning: the office or role of a trustee
items.example: Trusteeship names the office rather than the person.
items.exampleCN: trusteeship 指职位，而不是指人。

items.meaning: to place something in the care of another
items.example: To entrust a fund is to hand it over in confidence.
items.exampleCN: entrust a fund 就是把资金怀着信任交出去。

items.meaning: the person who creates a trust
items.example: The trustor signs the deed that creates the trust.
items.exampleCN: 信托设立人签署设立信托的契据。

items.meaning: money held in trust for a purpose
items.example: The trust fund pays for the schooling of the children.
items.exampleCN: 信托基金支付孩子们的学费。

items.meaning: the person who benefits from a trust
items.example: The beneficiary receives the income, not the title.
items.exampleCN: 受益人取得收益，而不是法定名义。

items.meaning: a company that acts as a trustee
items.example: A corporate trustee must keep separate records.
items.exampleCN: 法人受托机构必须保持独立的账目。

items.meaning: a violation of a duty owed as a trustee
items.example: Selling the land without permission is a breach of trust.
items.exampleCN: 未经许可出售土地构成违反信托义务。

latinEntries.meaning: past-participle ending, hence one acted upon
latinEntries.meaningCN: 过去分词词尾，引申为动作的承受者

definition_zh: 无力偿债；资不抵债；破产
definition_en: the state of being unable to pay debts as they fall due
core_image: 一只倒空的钱袋，账单还压在桌上
scene: 公司账面资产不少，却拿不出现金还债，只能申请无力偿债程序。The company had assets on paper but no cash, so it filed for insolvency.
sceneCN: 这里 insolvency 是「无力偿债」（第 1 个义项：无法按期清偿债务的状态）；句意：公司账面上有资产，却没有现金，于是申请无力偿债。

pos.zh: 无力偿债；资不抵债；破产

collocations.zh: 申请破产；申请无力偿债
破产执业人；破产管理人

derivatives.zh: 无力偿债的：in-（否定）+ solvent（有偿付能力的）
偿付能力：solvent + -cy（表示状态的名词后缀）
有偿付能力的：拉丁语 solvere（解开；清偿）的现在分词

senses.title: Inability to pay debts as they fall due
senses.definition: the condition of a person or company that cannot pay its debts when they become due
senses.definitionCN: 个人或公司到期无法清偿债务的状况
senses.example: The auditor warned that the firm was close to insolvency.
senses.exampleCN: 审计师警告说这家公司已接近无力偿债。
senses.why: The prefix in- says no to solvency, and solvency is the ability to pay, so the word names the lack of that ability.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 in- 否定了 solvency，而偿付能力就是还债的能力，所以这个词指这种能力的缺失。

senses.title: The legal status of a failed debtor
senses.definition: the status of a debtor once a court or a statute treats the inability to pay as established
senses.definitionCN: 法院或成文法认定债务人无法清偿后所具有的地位
senses.example: Once insolvency was declared, the creditors could no longer sue for payment.
senses.exampleCN: 一旦宣告破产，债权人就不能再起诉要求付款。
senses.why: The plain fact becomes a legal status once a court or a statute declares it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦法院或成文法作出认定，单纯的事实就变成一种法律地位。

senses.title: Liabilities exceeding assets
senses.definition: a situation in which total liabilities exceed total assets
senses.definitionCN: 负债总额超过资产总额的情形
senses.example: Balance-sheet insolvency can exist even while the company still pays its bills.
senses.exampleCN: 即使公司仍在支付账单，资产负债表意义上的资不抵债也可能已经存在。
senses.why: Accountants measure the same idea by setting liabilities against assets.
senses.whyCN: 会计人员把负债与资产对照，度量的是同一种状况。

senses.title: Failure of a bank or an insurer
senses.definition: the failure of a bank or an insurer to meet its obligations, handled under special rules
senses.definitionCN: 银行或保险公司无法履行义务、按特殊规则处理的情形
senses.example: Bank insolvency is handled by the regulator rather than by ordinary creditors.
senses.exampleCN: 银行无力偿债由监管机构处理，而不是由普通债权人处理。
senses.why: A bank failure touches many depositors, so the word gains a regulatory sense with special rules.
senses.whyCN: 银行倒闭会波及众多存款人，因此这个词在特殊规则下多出一层监管含义。

senses.title: Exhaustion beyond money
senses.definition: a figurative state of having no resources left to meet an obligation
senses.definitionCN: 比喻意义上再无资源履行某项义务的状态
senses.example: The charity reached moral insolvency after the scandal.
senses.exampleCN: 丑闻之后，这家慈善机构在道义上已无力承担。
senses.why: The image of a purse with nothing in it extends to any obligation that can no longer be met.
senses.whyCN: 钱包里空无一物这一意象，扩展到任何再也无法履行的义务。

senses.title: The law and practice of failed debtors
senses.definition: the area of law and practice concerned with debtors who cannot pay
senses.definitionCN: 处理无法偿债的债务人的法律与实践领域
senses.example: She practises insolvency and restructuring for mid-sized manufacturers.
senses.exampleCN: 她为中型制造商处理破产与重组事务。
senses.why: Practice names the field after its subject matter, so insolvency also means the work itself.
senses.whyCN: 实务界用研究对象来称呼领域，因此 insolvency 也指这项工作本身。

intro.en: Insolvency comes from Latin insolventia, the state of a debtor who cannot loosen, and therefore cannot pay, a debt.
intro.cn: insolvency 来自拉丁语 insolventia，指债务人解不开、因而付不清债务的状态。

items.en: Solvere means to loosen, and by extension to pay a debt.
items.cn: 拉丁语 solvere 意为解开，引申为清偿债务。

items.en: The prefix in- negates the word, so insolvens means not able to loosen or pay.
items.cn: 前缀 in- 表否定，insolvens 即解不开、付不出。

items.en: Insolventia names the condition of the debtor who cannot pay.
items.cn: 拉丁语 insolventia 指债务人无力清偿的状态。

items.en: Insolvent enters English as an adjective for a debtor who cannot pay.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语 insolvent 作形容词，指无力偿债的债务人。

items.en: Insolvency turns the adjective into the name of the state.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 insolvency 把形容词转为状态名词。

items.en: Statutes and regulators give insolvency its technical legal sense.
items.cn: 现代英语中，成文法与监管机构赋予 insolvency 专门的法律含义。

note.en: Insolvency is the state word of the solvere family, close to its adjective, its opposite, and the legal procedures for debt.
note.cn: insolvency 是 solvere 词族中的状态名词，与它的形容词、反义词以及处理债务的法律程序相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 无力偿债的（insolvency 的形容词）
偿付能力（加前缀 in- 后意义相反）

entries.definition: to find an answer to a problem
entries.definitionCN: 解答；解决（与 solvere 同源，但义为解开难题）

entries.definition: a legal procedure for a debtor who cannot pay
entries.definitionCN: 破产（处理无力偿债者的法律程序）

entries.definition: failure to pay a debt when it is due
the winding up of a company by selling its assets

normalIntro.en: Insolvency is built from the negative prefix in- and solvency, the ability to pay, so the word is a simple denial of that ability.
normalIntro.cn: insolvency 由否定前缀 in- 与表示偿付能力的 solvency 构成，因此这个词就是对那种能力的直接否定。

normal.en: The prefix in- simply says no to solvency, the ability to pay.
normal.cn: 前缀 in- 直接否定了 solvency，也就是偿付能力。

normal.en: Latin solvere first meant to loosen, then to loosen a debt by paying it.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 solvere 先指解开，再指把债务解开，也就是付清。

normal.en: Insolvency is the state; insolvent is the person or company in that state.
normal.cn: insolvency 是状态，insolvent 是处于该状态的人或公司。

normal.en: One letter n separates solvency from insolvency and flips the meaning.
normal.cn: 一个字母 n 把 solvency 与 insolvency 分开，也把意思翻了过来。

normal.en: Insolvency law deals with debtors who can no longer pay their way.
normal.cn: 「insolvency law」处理再也付不出钱的债务人。

abstract.en: Picture a purse turned upside down with nothing falling out.
abstract.cn: 想象一只倒过来的钱袋，什么也倒不出来。

abstract.en: See a stamp landing on a court file that marks the debtor as unable to pay.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚印章落在法院卷宗上，把债务人标记为无力偿债。

abstract.en: Think of a balance sheet whose liability column is longer than the asset column.
abstract.cn: 想象资产负债表上负债一栏比资产一栏更长。

examples.en: The group filed for insolvency after two years of losses.
examples.cn: 该集团在连续两年亏损后申请破产。

examples.en: Insolvency proceedings began when the bank refused further credit.
examples.cn: 银行拒绝继续放贷后，破产程序启动了。

examples.en: Directors can be liable if they trade while the company is insolvent.
examples.cn: 如果公司在无力偿债时仍继续经营，董事可能要承担责任。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因欠」——因为欠债太多而还不上，就是无力偿债；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ solvere（解开；清偿）→ insolvens（付不出的）→ insolventia（无力清偿的状态）→ 英语 insolvency，核心义「解不开债务」。

sensesIntro.en: Insolvency starts as the plain inability to pay, becomes a legal status and a balance-sheet measure, then branches into bank failure, figurative exhaustion, and the law of failed debtors.
sensesIntro.cn: insolvency 从「付不出钱」这一朴素事实出发，成为法律地位与资产负债表上的度量，再分出银行倒闭、引申的枯竭与破产法领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a purse turned upside down with nothing falling out.
core.cn: 核心意象：倒过来的钱袋，什么也倒不出来。

branches.en: The plain inability to pay is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 单纯的付不出钱，是日常义项。

branches.en: A court or a statute turns the fact into a legal status.
branches.cn: 法院或成文法把这一事实转为法律地位。

branches.en: The balance-sheet measure sets liabilities against assets.
branches.cn: 资产负债表上的度量，是把负债与资产对照。

branches.en: Special rules for banks add the regulatory sense.
branches.cn: 针对银行的特殊规则，多出一层监管含义。

branches.en: Figurative exhaustion and the field of practice extend the word beyond money.
branches.cn: 引申的枯竭与实务领域，把这个词扩展到金钱之外。

intro.en: Insolvency is built from the Latin negative prefix in- and solvere, the verb that means to loosen and therefore to pay.
intro.cn: insolvency 由拉丁语否定前缀 in- 与 solvere 构成，后者意为解开，因而也指清偿。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere loosens a knot and loosens a debt; insolvens is the debtor who can do neither.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 solvere 既能解开绳结，也能解开债务；insolvens 就是两者都做不到的债务人。

items.example: The prefix in- negates solvere in insolvency.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 在 insolvency 中否定了 solvere。

items.example: Solvere gives both solve and insolvency.
items.exampleCN: solvere 既给出 solve，也给出 insolvency。

items.example: Insolvens describes the debtor who cannot pay.
items.exampleCN: insolvens 描述付不出钱的债务人。

items.example: The company was insolvent by the end of the year.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司在年底已无力偿债。

items.meaning: the state of being unable to pay
items.example: Insolvency is the state, not the procedure.
items.exampleCN: insolvency 指状态，而不是程序。

items.example: A solvent company can meet its bills.
items.exampleCN: 有偿付能力的公司能付清账单。

items.example: Solvency is what the prefix in- removes.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 去掉的正是 solvency。

items.example: Solve keeps the image of loosening a knot.
items.exampleCN: solve 保留了「解开绳结」的意象。

items.example: A solution unties the difficulty.
items.exampleCN: solution 把难题解开。

items.meaning: to break up or bring to an end
items.example: Dissolve shares the loosening image of solvere.
items.exampleCN: dissolve 与 solvere 共享「解开」的意象。

latinEntries.meaning: the state of being unable to pay

definition_zh: 发票；货物清单；开具发票
definition_en: a document that lists goods or services supplied and states the money owed for them
core_image: 一张写清货品与价钱的单据，随货一起递到买方手上
scene: 货已送到，卖方把一张写清数量与价钱的单据交给买方，约定期末付款。The seller sent an invoice with the goods and asked for payment within thirty days.
sceneCN: 这里 invoice 是「发票」（第 1 个义项：列明货物或服务与应付金额的单据）；句意：卖方随货寄出发票，要求三十天内付款。

derivatives.zh: 开票；开票业务：invoice + -ing（动作或业务名词化）
已开票的：invoice + -ed（表示已完成的过去分词后缀）

senses.title: A bill for goods or services supplied
senses.definition: a document that lists goods or services supplied and states the sum to be paid
senses.definitionCN: 列明所供货物或服务并写明应付金额的单据
senses.example: The invoice shows ten boxes at forty pounds each.
senses.exampleCN: 发票上列着十箱货物，每箱四十英镑。
senses.why: Old French envois meant things sent, and the paper that travels with sent goods became the bill.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 envois 意为发送之物，随货同行的单据于是成了账单。

senses.title: A record of a sale kept for tax
senses.definition: a sales document used to record tax and to support a claim for payment
senses.definitionCN: 用于记录税款并作为付款请求凭据的销售单据
senses.example: Keep every invoice for six years for the tax office.
senses.exampleCN: 每张发票都要保存六年，以备税务部门查验。
senses.why: Because the paper proves that a sale took place, it also serves tax accounting.
senses.whyCN: 这张纸证明交易确实发生，因此也服务于税务记账。

senses.title: The amount named on the bill
senses.definition: the sum of money written on a bill, treated as a debt owed
senses.definitionCN: 账单上写明的金额，被视为应付的欠款
senses.example: The invoice for the repairs came to two thousand pounds.
senses.exampleCN: 维修费发票的金额达到两千英镑。
senses.why: Metonymy lets the paper stand for the debt that it records.
senses.whyCN: 借代让这张纸代表它所记录的欠款。

senses.title: To send a bill to a customer
senses.definition: to send a bill to a customer for goods or services supplied
senses.definitionCN: 就所供货物或服务向客户寄送账单
senses.example: We invoice clients at the end of each month.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在每月末给客户开票。
senses.why: The noun became a verb, meaning to do what one does with an invoice.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，表示做与发票相关的事。

senses.title: A list of goods for customs
senses.definition: a detailed list of goods shipped, used by customs or carriers
senses.definitionCN: 随货列明货物细目的清单，供海关或承运人使用
senses.example: The customs invoice lists each item and its value.
senses.exampleCN: 报关发票逐项列明货物及其价值。
senses.why: The word began as a list of things sent, so the shipping-list sense survives in trade.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指发送之物的清单，因此货运清单义在贸易中保留下来。

senses.title: A digital bill issued by a system
senses.definition: a digital bill sent through a network and recorded in a system
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络发送并记入系统的数字账单
senses.example: The platform issues an electronic invoice the moment the order is paid.
senses.exampleCN: 订单一付款，平台就开具电子发票。
senses.why: The document moved online, and the old name moved with it.
senses.whyCN: 单据搬到线上，旧名称也随之搬了过去。

intro.en: Invoice comes from French envois, things sent, from en voie, on the way, and ultimately from Latin via, a road.
intro.cn: invoice 来自法语 envois（发送之物），出自 en voie（在途中），最终可溯至拉丁语 via（道路）。

items.en: Via means a way or a road.
items.cn: 拉丁语 via 意为道路、路途。

items.en: En voie means on the way, and envoyer means to send.
items.cn: 古法语 en voie 意为在途中，envoyer 意为发送。

items.en: Envois, literally things sent, names a shipment and the list that goes with it.
items.cn: 古法语 envois 字面为发送之物，指一批货物及随货清单。

items.en: Invoice enters English as a list of goods shipped.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 invoice 指随货运送的货物清单。

items.en: The list of goods becomes the bill for them, and tax rules fix its form.
items.cn: 现代英语中货物清单转为账单，税务规则又固定了它的格式。

items.en: Electronic invoicing keeps the old name for a digital document.
items.cn: 现代英语中电子开票让这个旧名沿用为数字单据。

note.en: Invoice looks like a prefixed word but is really a French noun for things sent, and it sits beside billing and payment words.
note.cn: invoice 看起来像带前缀的词，实际是法语中表示发送之物的名词，并与开票、付款类词相邻。

entries.definition: the sound a person makes when speaking
entries.definitionCN: 嗓音；说话声（只是拼写相近，词源不同）
已开票的（invoice 的过去分词）

entries.definition: a sending, or a closing stanza of a poem
entries.definitionCN: 发送；诗末的跋诗（与 invoice 同出 envois）

entries.definition: a statement of money owed for goods or services
a written proof that payment has been made
entries.definitionCN: 收据（证明已经付款，与发票相对）

entries.definition: a summary of amounts due or paid over a period

normalIntro.en: Invoice is a paper that travels with goods: the French source means things sent, so the word carries movement inside it.
normalIntro.cn: invoice 是一张随货同行的纸：法语来源意为发送之物，所以这个词本身就带着「运送」的动感。

normal.en: Invoice and envois share the idea of something sent.
normal.cn: invoice 与 envois 共享「被发送之物」这一意思。

normal.en: The invoice travels with the goods, which is why the word once meant the shipping list.
normal.cn: 发票随货同行，所以这个词曾经指货运清单。

normal.en: Compare bill and invoice: a bill is everyday, an invoice is the commercial record.
normal.cn: 对比 bill 与 invoice：bill 更日常，invoice 是商业记录。

normal.en: Invoicing is the process; an invoice is the paper or the file.
normal.cn: invoicing 是流程，invoice 是那张纸或那个文件。

normal.en: A tax invoice must carry a number, a date, and the amount of tax.
normal.cn: 税务发票必须载明号码、日期与税额。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of paper riding on top of a crate as it leaves the warehouse.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸贴在木箱顶上，随箱子离开仓库。

abstract.en: See a clerk open a folder of numbered sheets so that every sale can be proved.
abstract.cn: 想象职员打开一册编了号的单据，让每笔销售都能被证明。

abstract.en: Think of the total at the foot of the page turning into a debt that must be paid.
abstract.cn: 想象页面底部的合计变成一笔必须偿还的欠款。

examples.en: Please send the invoice to our accounts department.
examples.cn: 请把发票寄给我们的会计部门。

examples.en: The invoice was paid by bank transfer on Friday.
examples.cn: 这张发票已在周五通过银行转账付清。

examples.en: Suppliers invoice the store monthly for the goods delivered.
examples.cn: 供应商每月就所供货物向这家商店开票。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因货」——因为发了货才开的单子，就是发票；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 envois（发送之物，出自 en voie「在途中」，可溯至拉丁语 via「道路」）→ 英语 invoice，核心义「随货发送的清单，后转指账单」。

sensesIntro.en: Invoice begins as a list of goods sent, becomes the bill for those goods, then splits into tax record, amount owed, verb use, customs list, and digital bill.
sensesIntro.cn: invoice 最初指发送货物的清单，随后成为这些货物的账单，再分出税务凭证、应付金额、动词用法、报关清单与电子单据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet of paper travelling on top of a crate.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸贴在木箱顶上，随货前行。

branches.en: The bill for supplied goods is the everyday commercial sense.
branches.cn: 为所供货物开具的账单，是日常商业义项。

branches.en: Tax rules turn the same paper into an accounting record.
branches.cn: 税务规则把同一张纸变成会计记录。

branches.en: The sum written on the paper stands for the debt it records.
branches.cn: 纸上写明的金额，代表它所记录的欠款。

branches.en: The verb and the digital bill show the document in action and online.
branches.cn: 动词义与电子发票，分别展示这张单据的动作与线上形态。

branches.en: Customs and carriers keep the original shipping-list sense.
branches.cn: 海关与承运人保留了最初的货运清单义。

intro.en: Invoice has no negative prefix: the in- is the tail of French envois, the word for things sent, so the spelling can mislead.
intro.cn: invoice 并没有否定前缀：其中的 in- 是法语 envois（发送之物）的词尾残留，因此拼写容易误导。

latinIntro.en: The French phrase en voie, on the way, goes back to Latin via, a road, which is the oldest layer of the word.
latinIntro.cn: 法语短语 en voie（在途中）可回溯到拉丁语 via（道路），这是这个词最古老的一层。

items.example: Latin via is the road behind envoy and invoice.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 via 是 envoy 与 invoice 背后的那条路。

items.example: Goods en voie are still travelling.
items.exampleCN: 「en voie」的货物还在途中。

items.example: Envoyer sends both the goods and the paper.
items.exampleCN: envoyer 既发送货物，也发送单据。

items.example: Envois is the direct source of invoice.
items.exampleCN: envois 是 invoice 的直接来源。

items.meaning: a bill for goods or services
items.example: Invoice keeps the image of goods sent.
items.exampleCN: invoice 保留了货物被发送的意象。

items.example: The invoiced amount must match the order.
items.exampleCN: 已开票的金额必须与订单一致。

items.meaning: the act or business of issuing invoices
items.example: Electronic invoicing replaced the paper book.
items.exampleCN: 电子开票取代了纸质票据簿。

items.example: Voice is only a spelling neighbour of invoice.
items.exampleCN: voice 只是 invoice 的拼写邻居。

items.example: A bill is the everyday word for an invoice.
items.exampleCN: bill 是 invoice 的日常说法。

items.meaning: proof that payment has been made
items.example: A receipt follows an invoice once it is paid.
items.exampleCN: 发票付清之后会有一张收据。
